title: Design System: Forest International School Paris

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared easing; reduced motion disables movement.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Primary action on a light surface.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.75rem;min-height:48px;border-radius:var(--radius-control);font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);background:var(--color-forest-green);color:white;border:0;padding:12px 24px}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--color-forest-dark)}.ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-forest-green); outline-offset: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px white; }

components.name: Gold button
components.description: Primary action on the dark hero or visit section.
components.css: .ds-gold{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.75rem;min-height:48px;border-radius:var(--radius-control);font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);background:var(--color-gold);color:var(--color-forest-dark);border:0;padding:14px 24px}.ds-gold:hover{background:#e0c78f}.ds-gold:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-forest-green); outline-offset: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px white; }

components.name: Text link
components.description: Supporting navigation with a persistent underline.
components.css: .ds-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;gap:.625rem;color:var(--color-forest-green);font:600 16px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.3em;text-decoration-thickness:1px}.ds-link:hover{color:var(--color-forest-dark)}.ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-forest-green); outline-offset: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px white; }

components.name: Navigation link
components.description: A single navigation destination with a clear current-page state.

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;background:white;gap:.25rem;font:500 15px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:12px;color:var(--color-text);border-radius:var(--radius-control);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--color-surface);color:var(--color-forest-green)}.ds-nav [aria-current]{color:var(--color-forest-green);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.35em}.ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-forest-green); outline-offset: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px white; }

narrative.overview:
A parent is comparing schools on a phone during the day, looking for the age range, location, curriculum, fees and a way to visit. Clear light surfaces support that reading; the established forest green gives the school a recognisable presence. The reference is this site's published school material and existing identity, rather than a borrowed marketing template.

The voice is warm, grounded and expert, as defined in `PRODUCT.md`. Lead with information a family can use. Use the school's existing photographs, video, staff portraits and campus overview with accurate descriptions. An illustration is not evidence of a photographed place.

The homepage uses a maximum 72rem container, fluid section spacing, short introductory text and varied layouts suited to each subject. Programme links use images with copy beneath them; teaching details use a definition list; parent quotations remain verbatim. Shared navigation uses an 80rem container to accommodate its links.
keyCharacteristics: Published imagery with clear, readable captions and supporting text.
Solid actions, flat surfaces and restrained motion.
Keyboard access and readable text at every viewport.
dos: Do build trust with concrete school evidence, published material and practical details.
Do structure information around age fit, curriculum, location, fees and how to visit.
Do preserve school facts, parent quotations, names, links and policy commitments.
Do keep the school warm, grounded and expert, with natural British English.
Do test navigation, dialogs, focus, reduced motion and widths from 320px through desktop.
Do review the rendered page as well as the automated detector results.
donts: Don't use generic AI school marketing, vague benefits of bilingual education, abstract claims about nurturing potential, stock-sounding education copy or unsupported superlatives.

Don't use repeated identical card grids, pill labels above every section, oversized rounded cards, soft-shadow decoration, generic green nature branding or design flourishes that do not help a parent make a decision.

Don't invent facts, retain stale dates as current, introduce inconsistent contact details, add new photos of children without explicit approval, expose pupil personal data or make claims without a canonical source.
Don't make the site feel like a luxury school brochure, a corporate SaaS landing page, a playful children's brand or a formal government institution.
Don't use decorative leaf motifs, glass panels, metric tiles, animated bouncing arrows, gradient text or coloured side-stripe borders.
Don't silently change fees, dates, staff, ages, hours or policies during a visual cleanup. Follow `CLAUDE.md`.
